article.story: CLINTON, S.C. -- — Carl Parrish scored 23 points as Presbyterian beat Mercer 88-84 on Wednesday. Parrish added five rebounds for the Blue Hose (1-3). Chidi Chiakwelu scored 15 points and added nine rebounds and five blocks. Triston Wilson shot 3 of 5 from the field and 6 for 10 from the line to finish with 12 points, while adding seven rebounds and nine assists. K.J. LaMonte led the Bears (2-4) in scoring, finishing with 33 points. Shane Cherry added 15 points and three steals for Mercer. Quinton Perkins II finished with 11 points and two blocks. Up next Both teams next play Saturday. Presbyterian visits Tennessee Tech and Mercerplays Charleston Southern at home. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
